setup.title: Setup
setup.subtitle: Choose your language, rendering mode and local game files.
setup.languageNote: English is the only installed interface language.
setup.rendererNote: Applied at the next start. This is your saved preference, not a temporary fallback mode.
setup.drop: Type a path, browse or drop a file here.
setup.browserFiles: Browse or drop a local file. Browser selections must be reselected after reopening.
setup.invalidPath: This file is unavailable. Finish editing the path or select a local file.
setup.ready: Game files are compatible. Open a new tab to continue.
setup.missingPak: Select a PAK file to continue.
setup.missingMapping: Select a USMAP file to continue.
setup.mappingValid: USMAP parsed the representative game data successfully.
setup.openFailed: Could not open the selected game inputs. Check the PAK and USMAP files.
setup.mappingIncompatible: The mappings could not read this game data. Select compatible, up-to-date mappings.
setup.versionChanged: The game version changed. Verify that you are using the latest USMAP file.
setup.persistenceFailed: Preferences could not be saved. Your existing saved file has not been deleted.
setup.invalidFormat: This timestamp format is invalid or produces an unsafe filename.
setup.reselect: Local file access is unavailable. Select your game files again.
